partition_rule: Remove protocol-specific outer material test first; per remaining domain/class assign floor(.1*n) validation and floor(.1*n) internal test, then all remaining rows to training.
anchor_rule: Per target-training class choose min(n,max(1,floor(.1*n+.5))) anchors using the registered anchor seed; round half upward; validation/internal/outer test rows cannot be anchors.
stable_subseed: First8bytes, little-endian, of SHA256 colon-joined string(partition_or_anchor_seed,protocol,heldout,domain/class as used).
